Sara — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the attached profile; Ben and I reviewed it and put together a concise set of options below. I've attached a redlineable term-sheet and a draft SOW you can circulate to procurement.

High-level commercial buckets (ballpark, subject to usage profile & final sizing):
- 12-month commit: baseline rate, smaller discount (typically ~10% off list for committed baseline). Best when you need flexibility.
- 24-month commit: mid-tier discount (~18-22% off list), we can include a small staging credit to help the pilot phase.
- 36-month commit: largest discount (~28-35% off list) and extended price protection; we can explore an additional early-payment credit if Quantara prepays a portion.

Ramp/start windows and activation options:
- Option A (fast start): billing begins on day 0 of activation; we can activate within 14 days after SOW signature if capacity is available.
- Option B (hold window): we can hold committed slots for up to 45 days post-signature without billing (limited to one 45-day hold per year).
- Option C (staged activation): pilot capacity (up to 20% of commit) activates immediately; remainder auto-activates on a 30/60/90 schedule tied to usage milestones in the SOW.

Sizing & throughput assumptions:
- For your profile, initial recommendation: start with a 10-GPU pool (A100-class equivalence) for pilot traffic; scale to 30 GPUs at steady state.
- Per-GPU throughput we assumed for modeling: ~1.2M tokens/hour for short-chat workloads; ~350k tokens/hour for long-context batching. We'll confirm after we see more token-length distribution.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Ben/Marissa to pick a guardrail pricing option and produce a 1-page term-sheet with exact $/GPU-hour and the discount schedule.
2) Quantara returns completed usage template with hourly% by day (fills the gaps).
3) We schedule a 30-minute call to finalize the ramp calendar and DocuSign path.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.pdf, DRAFT_SOW_Quantara.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call later this week.

—

Folks — quick internal note building on Evelyn's options.

Commercial counter suggestion (concise):
- 12m: list price with a 10% commit discount; allow a single 30-day hold; no staging credits.
- 24m: 20% commit discount; include a 1-month staging credit equal to 10% of monthly committed spend to offset onboarding costs.
- 36m: 32% commit discount; offer an additional 5% early-pay credit if Quantara prepays 3 months.

Operational guarantees & guardrails:
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated GPU pools (excl. customer-side network issues).
- Throughput guarantee: provide nominal per-GPU throughput figures in the SOW; include an allowance clause for 15% variance during pilot.
- Capacity hold: allow a single hold window (up to 45 days) with a nominal retention fee (we suggest 5% of monthly commit for hold duration).

Legal/compliance asks: loop in Legal for the hold/retention fee and Procurement team for PO terms. I'll propose a short term-sheet and send to Evelyn for redline.
